title: Binary Compound Stability Prediction
summary: A proof-of-concept materials informatics project predicting stable binary compounds from element pairs using a discretized 1D binary phase diagram as training labels. The SDV family (sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, copulas) is listed in requirements.txt but no call sites appear in the codebase, so its role could not be verified.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.2.1, ctgan==0.7.3, rdt==1.6.0, sdmetrics==0.10.1, copulas==0.9.0; no matching usage patterns found in code
